component.name: HoploDex
component.summary: Inventory of a firearm collection, kept on your computer

description.p: HoploDex keeps an inventory of a firearm collection: the firearms and their accessories, what is mounted on what, photos and documents, insurance coverage and what the collection is worth.

Everything stays on your computer, in an encrypted database you choose and open with a passphrase. HoploDex has no account and makes no network connection, and it can import and export spreadsheets and back up the collection.

While HoploDex is before version 1.0, it keeps a troubleshooting log on this computer, up to 4 MiB and for up to 14 days. It is designed to leave out your records, file names, passphrases and how many items you have. Nothing is sent anywhere, and you can read it before you share it. You can turn it off in About.

ul.li: About HoploDex shows the commit the build came from.
Files dragged from File Explorer on Windows are taken again.
A lock that comes while a database is opened, created or restored is honored.
What was saved stays visible when an import or its conflict resolution fails or stops.
The Linux package is now named hoplodex and replaces hoplo-dex, and declares everything it needs to run.
Stricter limits on photos, documents and imports, and less left on disk by the web view.

description.p: The first release: an encrypted inventory of firearms, accessories, photos, documents and insurance policies, with spreadsheet import and export and backups.
